summary: Aru territory part 1 (Aru and Ariwara health zones, Kakwa/Lugbara/Alur country on the Uganda and South Sudan borders) lies far north of the CODECO conflict in Djugu and of the ADF zone in southern Ituri, and has no known armed-group territorial control. Aru town (territorial seat, border post with Uganda) and the trading hub of Ariwara are assessed as held by state police with FARDC garrisons and border services. Rural villages are assigned to the PNC by default state presence; cross-border criminality and occasional South Sudanese armed spillover near the northern border are handled by FARDC and do not amount to control. NOTE: no web research could be done for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites blocked); all zones are default-presence assessments and should be re-checked.

sources.title: Kivu Security Tracker (Ituri incident data, background)

zones.description: Aru town (territorial seat, Uganda border post; all neighbourhoods: Aru Cité, Ania, Katanga, Bakhita, Buta, Eru Yofenyiri, Leri, Araba)
zones.evidence: Aru is the territorial capital and a major Uganda border crossing with territorial administration, PNC, DGM/customs and an FARDC presence; no armed-group control of the town is known. No web research could be done for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites blocked), so this is a default-presence assessment.

zones.description: Ariwara town (commercial hub; neighbourhoods Ariwara, Ovutsiri, Dema, Angiria, Apaa, Kuku)
zones.evidence: Ariwara is a large cross-border trading town near Uganda and South Sudan with permanent state police and services; no armed-group control is known. No web research could be done for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites blocked), so this is a default-presence assessment.

zones.description: Rural villages of Aru health zone / Aru secteur (Obang'a, Obhiaku, Ezoo, Adaru, Vis-à-vis, Opirivu, Yaba, Ongoyi, Ekanga, Essebi etc.)
zones.evidence: No reported armed-group activity or territorial control in Aru secteur; the Ituri armed conflicts (CODECO, ADF, Zaïre) are concentrated in Djugu, Irumu and Mambasa far to the south. Assigned to state police by default. No web research could be done for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites blocked), so this is a default-presence assessment.

zones.description: Rural villages of Ariwara, Adja, Laybo and Adi health zones in the unit (Ariko, Nderi, Edipi, Kuno, Abedju, Donzu, Rogale, Lea, Kikia, Essoko etc.), up to the South Sudan border
zones.evidence: No reported armed-group territorial control; FARDC hold positions along the Uganda/South Sudan borders against cross-border incursions and criminality, while villages are administered by chiefs and state police. Assigned to PNC by default. No web research could be done for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites blocked), so this is a default-presence assessment.
